messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the design review: rotate key UX needs clearer affordances. Users thought rotate would rotate metadata + secret; some assumed it would create a new key.

mira: Observed the same in testing. We should clarify: Rotate = replace secret, preserve name & scopes. Maybe call the modal 'Rotate secret' to be explicit.

sam: Suggest adding an inline summary at top of modal: 'Rotating will replace the secret immediately. Existing consumers will fail until the new secret is deployed.' Short and bold.

raghu: Accessibility: when modal opens, set focus on the modal heading and use aria-describedby to target that summary. Keyboard users should not land on the rotate button first.

design-bot: Also add a required confirmation checkbox: 'I understand rotating will break current consumers' with aria-required and aria-invalid when unchecked. Announce validation errors with aria-live="assertive".

alex: Copy nit: CTA should read 'Rotate secret' (destructive). Secondary 'Cancel'. Add tertiary 'Create replacement key' link for teams that prefer new key rotation pattern.

mira: Good idea. The tertiary action could open the create-key modal prefilled from the current key. Helps zero-downtime workflows.

sam: UI microflow: show a small line: 'Want zero downtime? Create a replacement key and swap in your services.' Link opens prefill flow.

raghu: For screen reader users, after rotate completes announce 'Key rotated. New secret visible once. Copy it now; you will not be able to view it again.' Use aria-live="polite" on the toast and focus the copy button.

design-bot: If we show secrets in a masked input, provide a 'Reveal secret' button that toggles aria-pressed and uses an accessible label like 'Reveal secret for <key-name>'. Also timer: mask again after 30s and announce via aria-live.

alex: Security/product note: log an audit event for rotate and include actor and reason if provided. Maybe offer optional 'reason' input in modal (not required) for enterprise auditability.

mira: Small layout ask: keep the rotate modal narrow and avoid large callouts; users in tests felt overwhelmed by long lists in that modal. Collapse usage lists with 'show more'.

sam: Also surface a 'how to roll out' short link: a one-line step list: 1) Create replacement key 2) Deploy new secret 3) Rotate old secret. Link goes to docs.

raghu: A11y checklist items I'll draft: focus on heading on open, aria-describedby for summary, checkbox with aria-required, aria-live for toast and reveal actions, ensure color not sole indicator for impact. I'll drop it here once ready.

design-bot: CSS/accessibility note: destructive button focus ring should be 3px solid #E35B4E; high contrast mode should swap to visible outline.

alex: Action items: mira to update Figma naming ('Rotate secret'), sam to add tertiary 'Create replacement key' flow sketch, raghu to post the a11y checklist, I'll coordinate docs link and auditing field.

mira: Will update mock + a small copy doc.

alex: Thanks all :thumbsup:

(End thread)
